name: all-contributors

schema.description:
The configuration file used by the All Contributors CLI and GitHub bot.
https://allcontributors.org/docs/en/bot/configuration

projectOwner.title: Name of the user the project is hosted by

repoHost.title: Points to the repository hostname
repoHost.description:
Change it if you use a self-hosted repository.
Default: https://github.com if repoType is github, and https://gitlab.com if repoType is gitlab

imageSize.title: Size (in px) of the user's avatar

commitType.description: UNDOCUMENTED: Sets Conventional Commits commit type to be used by the all contributors bot. See https://www.conventionalcommits.org.

contributorsPerLine.title: Maximum number of columns for the contributors table

contributorsSortAlphabetically.title: true: Sort alphabetically. false: Display in order of addition.

badgeTemplate.title: Your own lodash template to generate the badge

contributorTemplate.title: Your own lodash template to generate the contributor

types.title: Custom symbols or link templates for contribution types (can override the documented types)

symbol.title: Symbol to use for the contribution type

link.title: Link to use for the contribution type

linkToUsage.title: Adds a footer with link to usage

skipCi.title: Makes the CI ignore the commit

contributors.title: List of contributors for this project

profile.title: URL of the contributor's profile page or website

contributions.title: Array of contributions made by the contributor

schema.title: All Contributors configuration file

description:
The **OpenSource Toolkit** project, owned by **open‑dev**, lives on GitHub at **https://github.com**. The configuration is set for a GitHub repository and will automatically update both **README.md** and **CONTRIBUTING.md** whenever contributors are added. Avatars are displayed at **120 px**, and every contribution triggers an auto‑commit using the **angular** commit convention with a commit type of **docs**. The contributors table will show up to **8** contributors per line and will be sorted alphabetically. Badges are generated with the lodash template **`<%= contributor.login %>`**, while individual entries follow the template **`<%= contributor.name %> - <%= contributor.profile %>`**. A usage footer is disabled (**linkToUsage: false**) and CI is not ignored (**skipCi: false**).

Custom contribution types have been defined: the **code** type uses the laptop emoji **💻**, is described as “Code contributions”, and links to **https://github.com/open-dev/opensource-toolkit/commits**; the **doc** type uses the open‑book emoji **📚**, is described as “Documentation updates”, and links to **https://github.com/open-dev/opensource-toolkit/wiki**.

The current contributors are Alice Johnson (**login: alice123**) whose avatar is located at **https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/1234567?v=4**, profile at **https://github.com/alice123**, and who has contributed **code** and **doc**. The second contributor is Bob Lee (**login: bobdev**) with avatar **https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/2345678?v=4**, personal site **https://boblee.dev**, and contributions in **design** and **translation**.
